row: We are back!  Join me while I share my knowledge of equine massage, equine bodymechanics and horse training and horse care tips for horses and ponies and riders of all levels. Much of what a rider needs to know can be evaluated from the ground so our horse athletes can continue to perform in any horse competition with the best of health, equipment and movement. I will include horse tips and my favorite horse products and horse massage tools as well. If there is a subject you would like to see addressed just let me know.Check out our new Substack site for serious equestrians. There I go into great depth on all aspects of horse care, stable management and how to have a happy horse and productive barn. I also feature case studies.  Subscribe to this You Tube channel and MTEquine Essentials https://equinemassage.substack.com/
